// tag::body[]
Returns the full profile of all users in your Slack organization using the users.list API method. You can filter the returned users by team ID.

This input reads users with the https://api.slack.com/methods/users.list[`users.list`^] Slack API method and emits each user profile as a separate message. To return only the users of one team, set `team_id`.
// end::body[]
